name: Microsoft Intune / Entra ID Rollout
tagline: Endpoint management modernization with Intune and Entra ID.
description: A modernization rollout that moved Marshall Oil & Gas onto Microsoft Intune and Entra ID. Covers device enrollment, conditional access, and MFA enforcement across the fleet, alongside full M365 tenant administration. Also owned the end-to-end onboarding and offboarding workflows for every user.
